notes: I couldn't get any payee data for Illumina or its rivals from these sites with the fetch tool. The Texas Comptroller spending page has no payee search or CSV URL. It points to a QlikView dashboard ('Payments to Payee') at https://bivisual.cpa.texas.gov/CPA/opendocnotoolbar.htm?document=documents%5CTR_Master_UI.qvw. That dashboard returned only a 'Data Visualizations' heading, which looks like a JavaScript app shell with no static data. Ohio Checkbook (checkbook.ohio.gov) failed with a certificate error. Open Book NY redirected to osc.state.ny.us/open-book-new-york and I didn't follow it. fiscal.wa.gov lists an Open Checkbook page (Spending/Checkbook.aspx) but gave no query URL pattern. I stopped after 4 fetches and checked none of the four sites in a real browser. No payment figures were retrieved, so there is nothing to report on research versus public-health trends or on payments to Element, Ultima, PacBio or ONT.
how_to_mine: This needs a real browser or a headless one (Playwright), not a plain fetch. (1) Open the Texas Qlik dashboard, go to Payments to Payee, filter payee to Illumina, pick the fiscal year, and export to Excel. Do the same for Element Biosciences, Ultima Genomics, Pacific Biosciences and Oxford Nanopore. (2) Try the Washington Open Checkbook at fiscal.wa.gov/Spending/Checkbook.aspx. (3) Try Ohio Checkbook (it needs a TLS workaround) and NY Open Book. (4) Alternatives that may give static data: USAspending.gov, which has a public API for federal awards and subawards, and university-level purchase-order or vendor-payment portals such as UT Austin, Texas A&M and Ohio State vendor disclosures. Also try state bulk data on data.texas.gov (Socrata), which allows CSV export by URL. Socrata is the most promising route for a cheap pull.
new_candidates: data.texas.gov (Socrata) bulk datasets of state or university vendor payments, filtered for Illumina
USAspending.gov API, to compare federal awards to Illumina against rival vendors
